text: The Hindley-Milner type system is obtained from System F by restricting polymorphism to:
choices: rank-1 polymorphism (∀ only at outermost positions in let-bindings)
explanation: Hindley-Milner restricts to rank-1 (prenex) polymorphism: type variables are only quantified at the top level in let-definitions. This makes type inference decidable (Algorithm W).
